36 = -16t² + 80t

Rearranging:
16t² - 80t + 36 = 0

Dividing by 4:
4t² - 20t + 9 = 0

Using the quadratic formula:
t = (20 ± √(400 - 144)) / 8
t = (20 ± √256) / 8
t = (20 ± 16) / 8

This gives:
- t = 36/8 = 4.5 seconds
- t = 4/8 = 0.5 seconds
